verdict.rationale: The pack holds verbatim guidance text from many public gov.uk pages, including the organisation page, the browse index and deep pages such as Skilled Worker, Innovator Founder, Global Talent and processing times. That implies the reading surface was fetched as plain retrievable content, without keys or interactive challenges. None of the evidence explicitly addresses bot-wall policy, user-agent handling, JS rendering or CAPTCHA, so the capability is inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that fetches used a standard identified user agent, documentation of the absence of bot walls or CAPTCHA, evidence the pages are server-rendered rather than JS-only, and independent hands-on corroboration.
